title: Replay pinned GL3 RUP certificates on another native platform
body:
The [native-replay handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2102#discussioncomment-19080870) left by #4214/#4223/#4230 asks for actual execution of the saved PR4211 proofs on another platform. This supplies a bounded macOS arm64 / Apple Clang21 replay of the unchanged length7/8 formulas and RUP proofs, with source/compiler/binary provenance, exact raw logs and decisive native controls. The original Brian Ross/Codex contribution already produced these proofs and ran the same checker on Windows/MinGW; this is new execution of the **same checker implementation**, not a second checker algorithm or minimum-nine admission.

Both actual native runs return exit0 plus exact `s VERIFIED`, with zero RAT lemmas in the checked refutation cores. Inputs are18,882/30,591 variables,61,138/97,770 clauses, and3,657,455/108,920,783 decompressed proof bytes across39,177/587,886 records. All six native controls pass, including a required RAT-core proof accepted in default mode and rejected under `-U`. The checker can exit0 on errors, so exit code alone is never sufficient. Strict whole-container byte/hash/line/grammar checks remain separate from backward verification, which can skip unused proof additions.

Only `research/gl3-rup-native-replay/` and its dedicated read-only native workflow are added. Fourteen original exports retain exact bytes, Git blobs, notices and licenses through source ancestor `37fdc4122f84d80cccd85aa51f631acf79904003`. Official LF and predecessor-vendored CRLF C/license containers are distinguished and compared exactly without editing the executed bytes. No solver or new dependency installation is needed. One checker runs at a time with explicit CPU/wall/decompression/disk-reserve gates; no hard RAM cap or reliable peak RSS is claimed.

Validation: all55 package files and the external workflow match exact remote Git bytes at head `8a3ad12ff895640bb5031c1c1a5adfac189ca18c`. Two registered Python3.12 normal/optimized evidence-inspection commands pass from a cold Git-free export, retaining all56 exported files. Their public16-case receipt tests include13 meaningful rejection mutants. These stdlib commands inspect retained execution evidence; the separate Ubuntu native workflow compiles and freshly replays both proofs, preserving complete typed receipts and exact logs even after failure. Hosted results will be linked in the Discussion handoff after they complete.

Canonical main refreshed at submission remains `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority7. Final publication recheck20:33:54UTC covered351 open/draft PR bodies and live #1166/#2102 checked; broader coverage partial, no novelty inference. Original card scope is explicitly changed to this named certificate-interface replay. Separate code/receipt/workflow reviews and a final file seal are included. No merge, selected-frontier edit or new kappa.

Remaining: separately implemented/proof-kernel RUP checking, independent human acceptance and explicit model lower-bound admission naming normalization/support/compiler/padding/positive-witness dependencies. Changed models, physical compiler/caller/invoice, supplier and outer multiplication theorem remain separate.

Credit: Brian Ross's original strategy, direction, oversight, encoding, certificates and checker integration with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Hanson Sun seed18/Josie Elliston three-register lineage; James Reed's finite pin/seal review and the distinct #4214/#4223/#4230 audits; Marijn Heule/Nathan Wetzler's MIT drat-trim and original Glucose4/PySAT proof production. ToikY used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for this harness, evidence inspection and separate reviews. These are not independent human reviews. Maintainer edits disabled.
